start_here: Say to your AI: "List the environment and place-report inputs the repository in my granted folder /Work/demo-repo reads, without their values", with {}. It runs tool:list-a-repositorys-place-inputs on your computer and answers each input name, the files that read it and whether it is set.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it reads one folder you grant and answers, and keeps no row.
instructions: 1. Grant the tool read access to the repository folder (the read-a-folder grant).
2. Say "List the inputs this repository needs". The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:list-a-repositorys-place-inputs and {}.
3. Read inputs: each name, the tracked files that read it, whether it is a run switch and whether it is set here; values are never shown.
